column1: # Curated substring -> country overrides for submitting/sequencing
# organizations whose name does not contain a country or recognizable
# place name (so geo_provenance.py's country_from_text() has nothing to
# match on). Matched case-insensitively as a SUBSTRING of the submitter
# string; first match (by substring length, longest first) wins.
#   country must be a name geo_provenance.canonical_country() can resolve
#   (an ne_110m_countries.json name, or an entry in country_aliases.tsv).
# This table is intentionally small and user-editable -- add entries for
# any submitter that shows up in geo_provenance_report.tsv as "unresolved"
# but is in fact a known institution.
